name: application-token-balance-row
title: Token Balance Row
description: Wallet asset list showing each token's icon, name, held balance, USD value, and a direction-colored 24h change percentage.
useWhen: A crypto wallet or portfolio view needs to list held tokens with their current value.
Users need to see both the native-unit balance (1.842 ETH) and its USD equivalent at a glance.
Each asset benefits from a 24h change indicator to convey short-term movement.
avoidWhen: The list needs sorting, filtering, or many columns (cost basis, allocation %) — use a data table instead.
There's no live price data — a static holdings list without change percentages is simpler and avoids implying real-time accuracy.
The asset isn't a token/balance at all — use transaction-row for a movement/activity record instead.
responsiveBehavior: The list is a fixed max-w-sm block that fills its container's available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: Change direction is conveyed by both an arrow icon and text color, never color alone.
Balance and USD value are both always-visible text, so screen reader users get the same information sighted users do.
Token icon badges use text initials as a fallback identity marker; pair with a real logo image where available for stronger visual recognition.

variants.title: Token balance row
variants.description: Three-asset wallet list (ETH, BTC, SOL) with balances, USD values, and mixed positive/negative 24h changes.
accessibility: Each token's icon badge uses a distinct background/text color pair for quick visual differentiation.

variants.title: Token balance row (Dark)
variants.description: Token balance row adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Icon badge, value, and change-percent colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
